name: formatted-number
title: Formatted number
description: Numbers formatted for the reader: compact (1.2K), percent, unit or currency, in tabular figures with the full value kept for assistive technology.
docs: The Intl style option is called format here, because style belongs to CSS. percent takes a fraction (0.12 is 12%); currency needs currency and unit needs unit, which the types enforce, and if Intl still refuses a code it writes a plain decimal with the code. Compact figures keep the full number in the accessible name and a tooltip that opens on hover and on a tap; add focusable for a keyboard tab stop. null and NaN show the placeholder.
